recommended: Very light passive stretching in bed once fever breaks
Fever.notes: Exercising with a fever raises core body temperature to dangerous levels and risks severe illness or myocarditis. Rest completely.

Cold.notes: Follow the 'Above the Neck' rule. If symptoms are above the neck (runny nose, sneezing), light exercise is safe. If you feel body aches or chest congestion, rest.

Flu.notes: Flu impacts the entire body system. Do not exercise. Return to light activity only after being symptom-free for at least 48 hours.

Cough.notes: If the cough is chesty, productive, or accompanied by wheezing, avoid workouts. Ensure warm humid environment for any mild movement.

Sore Throat.notes: Light physical activity is fine if you have energy and no fever. Drink water frequently to keep throat hydrated.

Headache.notes: Light stretching helps if the headache is caused by neck tension. Avoid rapid head movements or heavy straining.

recommended: Very light restorative yoga once recovering
Diarrhea.notes: Dehydration risk is very high. Avoid sweating or heavy physical exertion. Keep workouts very short and keep water/electrolytes nearby.

avoid: Prolonged sitting exercises (stationary cycling for hours)
None - physical activity is highly recommended
Constipation.notes: Exercise stimulates the natural contractions of your bowel muscles. Staying active is one of the best ways to relieve constipation.

recommended: Very gentle stretching after symptoms break
Food Poisoning.notes: Your body has lost fluids and energy. Exercise is dangerous. Allow your stomach and hydration levels to fully normalize first.

recommended: None - sit or lie down in a cool shaded room
Dehydration.notes: Exercising while dehydrated can cause heat exhaustion, heat stroke, fainting, and severe muscle cramping. Rehydrate and rest.

avoid: Early morning outdoor running (peak pollen time)
Workouts near cut grass or blooming flowers
Seasonal Allergies.notes: Work out indoors when pollen counts are high. Wash your body and clothes immediately after being outside.
